tasks.objective: Create a reproducible Everloom distribution package with manifest and checksums.
acceptance_criteria: Packaging script creates an Everloom archive from an explicit allow-list.
Archive excludes credentials, caches and private runtime data.
Package contains SKILL.md, source, schemas, migrations, tests, documentation and license notices.
Package manifest records version, source revision, included files and SHA-256 checksums.

tasks.objective: Make CI validate and publish the Everloom package artifact.
acceptance_criteria: Focused Everloom tests run in CI.
CI runs package validation before upload.
A successful workflow run uploads the Everloom ZIP artifact.

tasks.objective: Finalize Everloom installation, operation, recovery and AI-skill documentation.
acceptance_criteria: Documentation names the skill Everloom and ID cowlsly-everloom.
Documentation explains installation, task opt-in, worker/reviewer loop, checkpoints, recovery and package verification.
External deployment prerequisites are clearly separated from core completion.

tasks.objective: Verify Everloom release readiness and produce the downloadable storage artifact.
acceptance_criteria: Focused CI is green on the release revision.
The package artifact is downloadable from the successful CI run.
No required core implementation item is knowingly marked complete without evidence.
